correctness.rationale: For crown graph Cr_n=K_{n,n} minus the diagonal matching with n≥3, the oriented edge space consists of n(n-1) coordinates a_ij (i≠j). The vertex-incidence cut space is constants plus two centered standard S_n modules; any S_n-equivariant map from this cut space into its Euclidean orthogonal complement is zero by stabilizer coefficient constraints; adjoints give the reverse cross-map. Consequently the Euclidean orthogonal cut/cycle projections are the unique equivariant projections, and averaging shows they minimize operator norms for every coordinate ℓp. Vertex Laplacian has nonzero eigenvalues n, n-2, 2(n-1), leading to a five-orbit signed column formula; summing absolute coefficients yields cut norm 3-4/n and cycle norm 2(2n²-6n+3)/(n(n-1)). Symmetry transfers ℓ1 columns to ℓ∞ rows. Directly built exact rational 2n×n(n-1) oriented incidences at n=3,4,5,6,7 and computed Moore-Penrose projectors: P²=P, ranks 2n-1, and both endpoint norms match every exact formula. Comparisons with intact K_nn give positive deletion gaps 2/n² and 2(3n-2)/(n²(n-1)), with crown crossover at n=5 versus intact n=4. The all-n proof relies on symmetry/eigen decomposition; finite tests are not exhaustive.
